prose: Forbes reports on OpenAI's Project Daybreak, a program that gives vetted partners access to OpenAI's top hacking models to find and fix vulnerabilities, which reportedly helped uncover PHP2Shell remote-code-execution bugs. The full reporting is behind Forbes' bot protection, so specifics of the program's scope and findings are not available here.
highlights: OpenAI's Project Daybreak lets vetted partners use its top hacking models to find and fix vulnerabilities (Forbes).
The program reportedly helped uncover PHP2Shell remote-code-execution bugs.
